name: What are the most common aging-in-place modifications?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common aging-in-place modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common aging-in-place modifications focus on safety and accessibility. These often include installing grab bars in showers and near toilets, creating curbless showers, raising toilet heights, and adding non-slip flooring. Other popular changes are widening doorways, improving lighting, installing lever-style door handles, and replacing stairs with ramps or stair lifts. Kitchen modifications might involve lower countertops or pull-out shelves for easier access.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include grab bars, curbless showers, wider doorways, improved lighting, and non-slip flooring, all designed for safety and accessibility.
